$comment: Registry of local patches. Each entry points at a patch module anywhere on disk. See README.md.

patches.name: Cap image resize dimensions
patches.description: Injects maxWidth/maxHeight after `{ ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options }` in pi's image resize code so the configured cap wins over the per-model catalog limit.
patches.notes: Migrated from ~/.pi/agent/extensions/patch-image-resize.js. Params come from PI_IMAGE_RESIZE_WIDTH / PI_IMAGE_RESIZE_HEIGHT (default 480 / 640).

patches.name: Coalesce model catalog refreshes
patches.description: Shares one in-flight promise between concurrent ModelRuntime.refresh() calls so registering N providers stops rebuilding the whole model catalog N times at startup.
patches.notes: Migrated from ~/.pi/agent/scripts/apply-optimizations.mjs (core patch). Applies to dist/core/model-runtime.js and the matching dist/bundle/chunks/*.js in every pi install found. Marker: PATCH(pi-refresh-coalesce-v2).

patches.name: Defer hermes memory startup work
patches.description: Sets lazyInitialization=true and quickCheckOnOpen=false in hermes-memory-config.json so the memory DB integrity scan and lock probe run on first use instead of during startup.
patches.notes: Migrated from ~/.pi/agent/scripts/apply-optimizations.mjs. JSON rewrite only touches the two keys; revert restores the runner's pre-patch backup.

patches.name: Precompile pi-hermes-memory
patches.description: Bundles pi-hermes-memory's TypeScript sources into dist/index.js with esbuild (watchdog + pi.extensions manifest wired) so pi stops transpiling 56 files through jiti on every start.
patches.notes: Migrated from ~/.pi/agent/scripts/build-hermes.mjs + apply-optimizations.mjs step 3. Runs as a task hook (build step, no file transform): rebuilds only when src/ is newer than dist/index.js. PI_ESBUILD_FROM / PI_HERMES_PACKAGE override discovery.

patches.name: Expose provider request hooks to extensions
patches.description: Adds ExtensionRunner#createProviderHooks() / ExtensionContext#providerHooks() so an extension can stream through pi's own before_provider_headers, before_provider_request, after_provider_response and provider_stream_event handlers. Lets out-of-band requests (HTTP gateways, scripts, nested agents) see key pools and payload transforms.
patches.notes: Applied to dist/core/extensions/runner.js, the matching dist/bundle/chunks/*.js, and dist/core/extensions/types.d.ts in every pi install found. Additive: existing callers pass no ctxOverride, so emit()/emitBeforeProviderRequest()/emitBeforeProviderHeaders() behave as before. Marker: PATCH(pi-hook-stream-v1).
